premises.text: The web is fragmented across sites and single-purpose apps, forcing users to assemble information via stacks of tabs
premises.evidence_span: we've traded the fluidity and connectedness of surfing for stacks of browser tabs and single-purpose mobile apps

premises.evidence_span: surfing the internet on web or mobile by weaving together services you use

premises.text: Semantic search and recommendations build contextual bridges across services
premises.evidence_span: we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations

premises.text: New user interfaces and interaction paradigms are designed from the ground up for this interconnected experience
premises.evidence_span: we also design from the ground up new user interfaces and interaction paradigms

value.text: Bring back fluid surfing of the internet across services on any screen
